scripts.//lint: --concurrency is a FIXED 4, never `auto` (#3276). Both eslint blocks are type-aware (src/** → tsconfig.json, e2e/** → tsconfig.e2e.json), so each worker builds its own TypeScript program — the win is real but the CPU cost is superlinear. Measured over src/ e2e/ playwright*.config.ts on an 18-core host: off 39.2s real / 57.6s user · 2 → 26.0s / 72.8s · 4 → 18.5s / 102.2s · 6 → 16.7s / 131.4s · auto → 18.5s / 181.3s. `auto` buys nothing over 4 in wall-clock while burning 78% more CPU, because it resolves to the host logical-CPU count and ignores any cgroup quota — the same trap api:test documents for pytest-xdist `-n auto`, where every co-tenant job on a multi-slot runner grabs the whole box. Keep this fixed if runner cores change; retune deliberately.
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: VITE_COVERAGE=true npm run build && playwright test && npm run coverage:e2e:merge
